name: alvinade98-laravel-blade-navigator
description: Ctrl+click Laravel Blade views (controller properties, module namespaces, Yajra DataTables) and flag controllers, services, FormRequests, models and DataTables that break the boilerplate standard.

commands.title: Scan file yang belum sesuai standar boilerplate

viewsWelcome.contents:
Tidak ada file yang menyimpang dari standar boilerplate.
[Scan sekarang](command:laravelBladeNavigator.scanDataTables)

laravelBladeNavigator.namespaces.description: Custom view namespaces mapped to view directories relative to the Laravel project root. Example: {"mahasiswa": ["Modules/Mahasiswa/resources/views"]}.

laravelBladeNavigator.dataTableDiagnosti.description: Show errors/warnings where controllers, services, FormRequests, models and Yajra DataTables depart from the boilerplate (thin controller, service layer, FormRequest validation, Eloquent only, getPageData() → with() → $this->view_path).

laravelBladeNavigator.rules.controller.markdownDescription: **Controller**: wajib `parent::__construct()`; tanpa validasi (`validate`, `Validator::make`), tanpa input dari `Request` biasa / `$request->all()`, tanpa model/Eloquent, `authorize()`/`Gate`, `response()->json()`, tanpa nama view hardcode (`view('ns::...')` → `$this->view.'...'`); info untuk `if`/`foreach`.

laravelBladeNavigator.rules.service.markdownDescription: **Service** (`Modules/*/app/Services`): tidak membaca `request()`/`session()`, tidak membuat `response()`/`view()`, tidak return `JsonResponse`/`View`; info bila tidak extends `BaseService`.

laravelBladeNavigator.rules.dataTable.markdownDescription: **DataTable**: `$this->view` yang selalu null, deklarasi `$tableId`, view cell di-hardcode, dan controller yang memanggil `render()`/`ajax()`/`html()` tanpa `->with($this->getPageData())`.

laravelBladeNavigator.rules.rawSql.markdownDescription: **Raw SQL** (semua layer): `DB::table/select/statement/raw` dan `selectRaw`/`whereRaw`/`orderByRaw`/… — Eloquent only. `DB::transaction` tetap boleh di service.
